integrity: Full proof and two sharp witness mechanisms supplied; finite rational tests corroborate without replacing the proof; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-rank result applies to vertex sets of uniform matroid base polytopes, not arbitrary matroid polytopes. The pointwise criterion covers smoothing parameters at least one. Older unindexed equivalent results cannot be ruled out; independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Sharp rank–corank convexification of hypersimplex vertex sets
